description: This file defines the PHP class 'Handling' which extends the system's Controller class within the OpenCart admin extension for total handling fees. It contains methods for rendering the handling settings page ('index') and saving configuration ('save'), related to total handling fee configurations in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: Controller class for managing total handling fee settings in the OpenCart admin extension for Total related configurations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Render the handling configuration page, load language, set title, prepare breadcrumbs, retrieve configs, load models, and render the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Process saving the handling configuration; check permissions, validate input, save settings via model, and return JSON response.
